title: The Bear and the Bees
summary: A bear stung by a bee lost his temper, attacking the hive. Swarms of bees attacked him, stinging him until he plunged into the river, learning that rage multiplies injury....
full_text: A bear stung by a bee lost his temper, attacking the hive. Swarms of bees attacked him, stinging him until he plunged into the river, learning that rage multiplies injury.
moral: Losing temper over a single sting invites a thousand stings.
